operation_depth_N: number of consecutive daily states in one non-overlapping coarse block
block_rule: partition from the anchor into non-overlapping full N-day blocks; discard trailing incomplete block
block_eligibility: at least ceil(0.80*N) finite daily states
block_value: arithmetic mean of finite canonical daily states
cell_eligibility: at least 30 eligible block values and finite nonconstant adjacent pairs
structure_score: Pearson correlation between consecutive eligible block values; pairs spanning an ineligible block are omitted
cyclic_difference: secondary score adds the last-to-first eligible block pair
closure_error: root mean square of finite differences omega[t]-omega[t-N], divided by station robust RMS, with at least 365 pairs
winner_N: per-parent argmin closure_error with the smaller N winning exact ties; study winner is the modal parent winner with smaller N winning frequency ties
